strings: m_c complains about feeling lightheaded whenever {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/stand/stands} up too quickly. After running a few tests, r_c has come to the conclusion that m_c has falling paws.
After m_c faints in the middle of the medicine den, the medicine cat diagnoses m_c with falling paws.
m_c has to sit down often when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/stand/stands} up. A Clanmate jokes about {PRONOUN/m_c/object} having a set of always falling paws.
m_c can feel {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} heartbeat when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/stand/stands} up.
